description: This file is a server-side route handler for a public invoice portal page in a SvelteKit project. It loads invoice data based on a token parameter from the URL, fetches invoice details from an API, handles errors, and returns structured invoice information along with default or template-specific styling options.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads invoice data based on URL parameters, handles potential errors, and returns invoice details along with style information and token.
